note: East Bay Regional Park District campground on the ridge above Lake Chabot near Castro Valley. The full-hookup RV sites are 1-12, by the entrance; most other sites are drive-up tent sites, and 13-22 are hike-in. Book at least two business days ahead. Gates are locked 10 p.m. to 8 a.m. No generators, no camp store. --Claude
